tool.name: Chimera.uchime
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat && #if $template.source == "self": ln -s '$template.count' template.count.dat && ln -s '$template.group' template.group.dat && #elif $template.source == "names": ln -s '$template.name' template.name.dat && #else: ln -s '$template.reference' template.reference.dat && ## mothur 1.48 regression: in reference mode it feeds an formatted copy of the ## query fasta to uchime, but only the de novo branch of the command creates ## that copy (it reads a temporary "[fasta]temp" file, which is written ## exclusively when reference=self). uchime ## therefore sees an empty query file and reports no chimeras at all. ## Writing the file mothur expects ourselves restores 1.46 behaviour. ln -s fasta.dat fasta.temp && #end if
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat") #if $template.source == "self": #silent $mothur_args.append("reference=self") #if float($template.abskew) > 0: #silent $mothur_args.append("abskew=" + str($template.abskew)) #end if #if $template.group: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=template.group.dat") #end if #if $template.count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=template.count.dat") #end if #elif $template.source == "names": #silent $mothur_args.append("name=template.name.dat") #else: #silent $mothur_args.append("reference=template.reference.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("minh=" + str($minh)) #silent $mothur_args.append("mindiv=" + str($mindiv)) #silent $mothur_args.append("xn=" + str($xn)) #silent $mothur_args.append("dn=" + str($dn)) #silent $mothur_args.append("xa=" + str($xa)) #silent $mothur_args.append("chunks=" + str($chunks)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minchunk=" + str($minchunk)) #if $idsmoothwindow: #silent $mothur_args.append("idsmoothwindow=" + str($idsmoothwindow)) #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("maxp=" + str($maxp)) #silent $mothur_args.append("minlen=" + str($minlen)) #silent $mothur_args.append("maxlen=" + str($maxlen)) #silent $mothur_args.append("skipgaps=" + str($skipgaps)) #silent $mothur_args.append("skipgaps2=" + str($skipgaps2)) #if $alignment.ucl == "local": #silent $mothur_args.append("ucl=true") #if $alignment.queryfract: #silent $mothur_args.append("queryfract=" + str($alignment.queryfract)) #end if #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("dereplicate=" + str($dereplicate)) #silent $mothur_args.append("chimealns=" + str($chimealns)) #silent $mothur_args.append("processors='${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8}'")
echo 'chimera.uchime(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log 2>&1 ## uchime component writes output to stderr #if $template.source == 'self' and $template.count: && if [ ! -s template.count.denovo.uchime.count_table ]; then cp template.count.dat template.count.denovo.uchime.count_table; fi ## mothur only writes that count table for 'hasCount && dereplicate', so with a ## count table that has no group columns and ## dereplicate=T nothing is produced. Never hand Galaxy an empty mothur.count_table: its ## set_meta() indexes the (empty) header list and the job dies with state 'error' and ## exit_code None. tools-iuc#5178; Galaxy side fixed in galaxy#24840 #end if

param.label: abskew - Abundance skew
param.help: Abundance skew is: min [ abund(parent1), abund(parent2) ] / abund(query). Default 1.9

param.label: group - Sequences Name reference
param.help: use the more abundant sequences from the same sample to check the query sequence

param.label: count - a count_table
param.help: Generated by count.seqs. When you use a count file with group info and dereplicate=T, mothur will create a count table containing seqeunces after chimeras are removed.

param.label: dereplicate - remove chimeric sequences from all groups?
param.help: If parameter is false, then if one group finds the seqeunce to be chimeric, then all groups find it to be chimeric

param.label: skipgaps - columns containing gaps do not count as diffs
param.help: controls how gapped columns affect counting of diffs

param.label: skipgaps2 - column is immediately adjacent to a column containing a gap, it is not counted as a diff
param.help: controls how gapped columns affect counting of diffs

param.label: chimealns - Produce a file containing multiple alignments of query sequences to parents in human readable format
param.help: Alignments show columns with differences that support or contradict a chimeric model.

param.label: minh - mininum score to report chimera. Default 0.3
param.help: Values from 0.1 to 5 might be reasonable. Lower values increase sensitivity but may report more false positives.

param.label: mindiv - minimum divergence ratio
param.help: to ignore very close chimeras, increase mindiv to 1.0 or 2.0, to increase sensitivity decrease minh to 0.1. Default 0.5

param.label: xn - weight of a no vote. Default 8.0
param.help: Decreasing this weight to around 3 or 4 may give better performance on denoised data

param.label: dn - pseudo-count prior on number of no votes
param.help: Reasonable values are probably in the range from 0.2 to 2.0. Default 1.4

param.label: xa - eight of an abstain vote
param.help: Reasonable values might range from 0.1 to 2.0. Default 1.0

param.label: chunks - number of chunks
param.help: number of chunks to extract from the query sequence when searching for parents. Default 4.

param.label: minchunk - minimum length of a chunk
param.help: Default 64

param.label: maxp - maximum number of candidate parents to consider
param.help: increasing maxp gives only a very small improvement in sensivity but tends to increase the error rate quite a bit. Default 2

param.label: minlen - minimum unaligned sequence length
param.help: Applies to both query and reference sequences. Default 10

param.label: maxlen - maximum unaligned sequence length
param.help: Applies to both query and reference sequences. Default 10000

param.label: idsmoothwindow - the length of id smoothing window
param.help: Default 32

param.label: ucl - Use local-X alignments
param.help: global-X is the default

param.label: queryfract - minimum fraction of the query sequence that must be covered by a local-X alignment
param.help: Default 0.5

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The chimera.uchime_ command reads a fasta file and reference file and outputs potentially chimeric sequences. The original uchime program was written by Robert C. Edgar and donated to the public domain (uchime_).
.. _chimera.uchime: https://mothur.org/wiki/chimera.uchime/ .. _uchime: http://drive5.com/uchime
**The count output**
mothur writes the ``uchime.count_table`` output only when the supplied count table carries group columns, i.e. it needs the per-group abundances to zero out the chimeric sequences. With a count table without group columns the tool therefore passes the input table through unchanged, so the output is never empty.
